author: SingleBlackMom
body:
IGN: SingleBlackMom
Infraction: Ban evasion
I am appealing this infraction because I was never ban evading. To play minecraft I use laptops given to us by our school, and so do many of my friends. All of these laptops have the same IP, so if you check the IPs of each one of us, it looks like we are all originating from one computer. If you do not believe me, ask Thomas_Shoes, he goes to my school and knows this too. 
I would never ban evade since I have learned my lesson from the first time I was banned, and I would not want to lose the privelige of playing on Avicus again. Thank you.
